summary: Worcester County, MA iron tower on Soapstone Hill; register dates Army use 1931-1941; a 1949 photo ties Petersham spotting towers to 1943-45 bombing targets; the Gate 37 hike now starts at Quabbin Reservoir.

facts.status_note: Register says some of the tower structure still stands; a November 2025 Peakery review places a fire tower near the Rabbit Run Rail Bed, not on the summit

access.note: The Soapstone Hill Loop starts at Gate 37 at Quabbin Reservoir; no source describes the tower remains as open to visitors

visit.trail_note: Soapstone Hill Loop (4.3 miles) starts at Gate 37; dogs barred from Quabbin trails; camping only in the Federated Women's Club State Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1931-1941 for the Army's tower. The 1949 photo record dates War Department spotting-tower structures in the Quabbin target areas to 1943-1945. The sources do not say these are the same structures.

The register says the tower spotted fires started by Air Corps practice bombing. The photo record calls its structure a spotting tower at a bombing target area. Both point to bombing practice but describe the job differently.

notes_for_editor: Register dates (1931-1941) conflict with the photo-record dates (1943-1945), and no source ties the numbered Quabbin spotting towers to Soapstone Hill. The brief's status 'gone' is contradicted by the register's own description, so the correction proposes partly standing. The Peakery item is a single visitor review. The 1949 Digital Commonwealth record is marked No Copyright - United States; its JPEG link was not retrieved, so no photo was added.
